lua: PREVIEW.assert_alerts_unchanged(); for _,open in pairs(PREVIEW.alert_sections) do assert(not open,'Alert groups must start collapsed') end; PREVIEW.assert_alert_counts({Food=0,['EXP chains']=0,Dedication=0,['EXP rings']=0,['Levels and merit points']=0,['Missed EXP']=0})
assert(settings.window.sections['Alerts/Levels and merit points'],'Opening group was not saved'); PREVIEW.scroll_target='level/Show notice'

assert(settings.alerts.events.level.visual and not settings.alerts.events.level.sound,'Notice checkbox changed the wrong flag'); assert(not settings.alerts.events.merit.visual,'Checkbox changed another alert'); PREVIEW.scroll_target='level/Play sound'

assert(settings.alerts.events.level.visual and settings.alerts.events.level.sound,'Checkboxes did not enable both'); assert(settings.alerts.events.level.file=='Custom.wav' and settings.alerts.events.level.volume==37 and settings.alerts.events.level.cooldown==12,'Toggling changed saved sound choices'); assert(PREVIEW.notification_calls==0 and not PREVIEW.sound_plays,'Enabling played a sound'); PREVIEW.scroll_target='level/Test notification'; PREVIEW.assert_alert_count('Levels and merit points',1)
assert(PREVIEW.notification_calls==1 and PREVIEW.notification_tested=='level','Test did not run exactly once for this alert'); PREVIEW.scroll_target='header/Levels and merit points'

assert(settings.window.sections['Alerts/Levels and merit points']==false and not PREVIEW.alert_sections['Levels and merit points'],'Collapse was not saved'); assert(settings.alerts.events.level.visual and settings.alerts.events.level.sound,'Collapsing disabled an alert'); PREVIEW.assert_alert_count('Levels and merit points',1)

assert(PREVIEW.alert_sections['Levels and merit points'] and settings.window.sections['Alerts/Levels and merit points'],'Reopening failed'); assert(PREVIEW.notification_calls==1,'Reopening ran another test'); PREVIEW.scroll_target='level/Show notice'; PREVIEW.assert_alert_count('Levels and merit points',1)

assert(settings.alerts.events.level.visual and settings.alerts.events.level.sound and not settings.alerts.events.merit.sound,'Saved independent choices changed'); PREVIEW.assert_alert_count('Levels and merit points',1)
